content.text: Service looks fine if updateByHash filters on hash. Check it.

candidates.explanation: updateByHash receives conditions {id, hash} but the TypeORM update only filters on `{ id: Number(conditions.id) }`. The hash condition is ignored, so a refresh token carrying a stale (already rotated) session hash still matches the session. The update then succeeds and a new token pair is issued. The document (Mongo) repository does filter on both _id and hash, so only the relational one is broken.

fix.description: Include the hash in the update's where clause: `this.sessionRepository.update({ id: Number(conditions.id), hash: conditions.hash }, { hash: payload.hash })`. If no row is affected, return null so AuthService.refreshToken throws UnauthorizedException.
